blocks.text: SOP: truck steering and suspension inspection

This is the working cut for RDW-SOP-2023-008 on January 19, 2023. Cal Dreher asked for a written bound after the current path (Align first because the rack is open) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Shop Helper, writing for Cal Dreher, Nina Soto, and Hank Morel. Primary host bay-02.ridgeway.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on align first to see if it 'takes care of it', then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Dry park, lift, tie-rod ends, bushings, then road test. Alignment is after the parts, not instead of them. I am not restating a hallway yes. align first to see if it 'takes care of it' is out because December 14 alignment on worn ends came back in 8 days. Nina had to explain a second bill. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: days=8, ends=2, weeks=3, wander=1, align=1, bill=2, park=1, lift=1. Sibling tickets RDW-2612 and RDW-SOP-2023-102. I will not reopen align first to see if it 'takes care of it' in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Nina Soto is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Hank Morel owns a leftover that is easy to skip: align.ridgeway.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (40): refuse on align first to see if it 'takes care of it', lock is inspect, parts, then align, wander is a measurement. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on RDW-2612.
A wander on the road test is a measurement, not a 'needs alignment someday.'

What a skeptical lead would try first on bay-02.ridgeway.internal: the path Cal Dreher actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on shop.ridgeway.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
